item.title: Implement specified retry delay budget behavior
item.brief: Implement retry_budget.py according to SPEC.md, preserving the documented retry_delay API. Expand focused standard-library unittest coverage beyond the basics for every specified validation rule and boundary case, including bool/float rejection, validation before exhausted returns, attempt limits, efficient saturation for huge attempts, zero base/cap, Retry-After floor beyond cap, and the strict elapsed+delay < budget boundary. Ensure the tests pass and commit the work as requested.

pr.body: Implemented built-in-int and range validation before exhausted returns, efficient capped backoff, Retry-After minimum waits, and strict budget handling in retry_budget.py. Expanded unittest coverage for validation types and bounds, validation ordering, attempt limits, huge attempts, zero base/cap, Retry-After beyond cap, and the strict budget boundary. Baseline `python -m unittest -v` failed all 3 starter tests because the function was unimplemented; final `python -m unittest -v` passes all 11 tests and `git diff --check` passes. No contributor guide or additional test configuration was present.
pr.summary: Implemented the documented retry delay policy. Callers now get validated, capped exponential waits that honor Retry-After and stop at the strict elapsed budget. Before: retry_delay raised NotImplementedError; now: the complete policy is covered by 11 passing tests.
